title: Correct cumulative sparkline discontinuities after late metering inserts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Observed small step jumps and negative deltas in per-tenant cumulative sparklines when late metering events are backfilled. Symptoms appear after ingest-time insertions that affect prior buckets; charts show discontinuities and occasional brief drops in cumulative curves which confuse customers and break anomaly detection alerts. Root cause hypothesis: aggregation pipeline applies event-time bucketing + forward fill that doesn't reconcile overlapping late inserts with previously emitted snapshots, causing inconsistent reconciliation windows.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Run synthetic tenant replay that emits events with event_time shifted 2-36 hours in the past
2) Ingest with existing sharded ingest path (kinesis -> consumer -> staging table -> aggregator), intentionally pause aggregator and then resume to simulate backfill
3) Load console per-model daily and hourly sparklines for that tenant and observe step discontinuities around backfill boundary
4) Compare raw ledger (raw_events) with the reconstructed hourly aggregate used by charts to see mismatched deltas
proposed_solution: Adjust the aggregation reconciliation: introduce a deterministic merge step keyed by (tenant_id, model_alias, bucket_start) that materializes final token_count for each bucket by event_time watermark. Replace current delta-apply logic with idempotent 'upsert final-count' so late inserts replace prior provisional counts instead of producing additive diffs. Also add a short-term smoothing layer in the UI to hide sub-second anomalies while backend reconciliation completes.
acceptance_criteria: Console per-model cumulative sparklines show monotonic non-decreasing counts for daily/hourly views after backfills
Synthetic tenant replay tests no longer produce negative deltas or visible drops in cumulative lines
Existing alerts for sudden negative token deltas do not trigger during a reconciliation window
Latency for visibility of corrected counts after a backfill is documented and within SLO (<= 15 minutes for typical backfills)
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy aggregator change behind feature flag to canary region; 2) Run synthetic replays for canary tenants and validate kibana/console charts; 3) Gradual enable for 25% of tenants over 2 days; 4) Monitor reconciliation lag dashboard; 5) Flip global flag and deprecate temporary UI smoothing after 1 week of stable signals.
telemetry_checks: Add histogram metric: reconciliation.window_latency_ms by tenant_id and model_alias
Emit counter: upsert_conflicts_resolved_total when deterministic merge replaces provisional count
Add gauge: provisional_buckets_in_flight to know how many buckets are awaiting reconciliation
Console should log a reconciliation_state tag on sparkline requests when backend data is older than 5 minutes
